title: fix(lint)!: refuse a field-level predicate that reads through a reference field at objectstack validate
body:
Fixes #20078

Clause-②: no

## What changes

`objectstack validate` (and `build` / `lint`, which run the same authoring rule) now refuse a field-level `requiredWhen` / `readonlyWhen`, or a select option's `visibleWhen`, that reads THROUGH a reference field (`lookup` / `master_detail` / `user` / `tree`) — `record.account.tier`. The refusal is an `expression-invalid` error located at the slot (`object 'O' · field 'F' requiredWhen`, `… readonlyWhen`, `… option 'V' visibleWhen`), naming the reference path and the related column(s), with the repair that is true for the root the predicate reads:

- `record.REF.COL` — "Express the check as a `validations[]` `script` rule, or read a column this object declares." These are the same words the runtime's own refusal of this fault carries (`unevaluableFieldRuleError` in `rule-validator.ts`), so the author meets one repair at both ends.
- `previous.REF.COL` — no seam hydrates `previous`, a validation rule included, so the repair is to compare the reference itself or read an own column.
- `parent.REF.COL` on a master-detail line item (judged against the master's declared field types) — no validation rule binds `parent`, so the repair is a column the master declares.

This is remedy A as triage routed it (comment 5825661201). Remedy B, hydrating the field level, is not attempted. The runtime is untouched.

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` | `refuseFieldTraversal` in the field walk (requiredWhen, readonlyWhen, option visibleWhen); `fieldTraversalMessage`; `singleMasterOf` |
| `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts` | 18 cases: 10 refusals (each slot, each root, the null-safe spellings, one error per reference) and 8 controls |
| `packages/cli/test/validate-field-predicate-traversal.test.ts` | the validate door, spawned (integration project, queue tier): a traversing config exits 1 with exactly three `expression-invalid` errors carrying the prescription; a control config exits 0 |
| `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` | `.describe()` and TSDoc of the three slots state the rule |
| `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.field-predicate-reference-traversal-refused.ts` + regenerated `registry.ts` | ADR-0087 semantic entry |
| `content/docs/references/**` | regenerated by `gen:docs`, not hand-edited |
| `.changeset/20078-field-predicate-reference-traversal-refused.md` | `@objectstack/lint` + `@objectstack/spec` minor, declared breaking (`!` and banner), disposition `registered` |

## The dispatch's mechanism hypotheses, measured

- **H1 — confirmed at the door.** On the unfixed tree (lint dist built from `49144fc` sources; `grep -c` of the new code in `packages/lint/dist/index.js` = 0), `objectstack validate` over a config carrying all three traversing predicates printed `Validation passed`, exit 0. With the fix the same config exits 1 (the CLI test above).
- **H2 — the shared judgment exists; nothing on the runtime side moved.** The runtime names a field-rule traversal fault with `@objectstack/formula`'s `analyzeRelationshipTraversals` plus the reference arbiter (`referenceTargetOf` over `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES`). The lint pass composes the same two: `analyzeRelationshipTraversals` imported from `@objectstack/formula`, `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES` from `@objectstack/spec/data` (the set `validateExpression`'s own traversal-conflict arm asks). The runtime has no pre-evaluation field-level check to import; it detects the fault after evaluation. No `domain:engine` file is touched.
- **H3 — the `current_user` option shapes stay accepted.** Only `record` / `previous` / `parent` member chains are analysed, so `current_user.can('trav_order', 'edit') && 'admin' in current_user.positions` on an option is a pinned control (lint unit test and the CLI control config), green before and after.
- **H4 — the route is `registered`.** The rule text: a narrowing of a published accept set is a breaking change (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`, AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3), and a declared-breaking changeset must carry an ADR-0087 disposition (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`). The candidates: `no-migration-prescription` is refused by the gate when the changeset carries a rewrite recipe, and this one must (the fix is a rewrite into a `validations[]` rule), so claiming it would rest on a detector miss; `registered` gives deployed metadata a structured TODO in the step-18 semantic list, which is what triage asked for (「按 ADR-0087 的规则登记这条收窄,写更新说明」). No D2 conversion: turning a field predicate into a validation rule inverts it into a failure condition and changes form behaviour, which is the author's judgement. Gate reading: `✓ check-adr-0087-registration: 1 declared-breaking changeset(s) … [BREAKING+bang] registered field-predicate-reference-traversal-refused (new here: field-predicate-reference-traversal-refused)`.
- **Census (in-repo half).** Through the lint rule itself: platform objects — 50 objects, 0 field-predicate slots present, 0 refusals, positive control (one injected traversal) fired 1; `examples/app-showcase` objects — 24 objects, 12 field-predicate slots present, 0 refusals. Through the validate door: `app-todo`, `app-crm`, `app-multi-package` valid, 0 errors. `app-showcase` could not load at the door locally (`connector-mcp` dist not built), hence the object-level reading above. Deployed metadata: NOT MEASURED.

## The runtime behaviour the messages state (engine probe, scratch file, not committed)

In-memory driver, objectql at base source:

| Shape | Outcome |
|---|---|
| `requiredWhen: record.account.tier == 'enterprise'` — insert, and an unrelated update | both REFUSED, `rule_violation` / `unevaluable`, "reads 'tier' through 'account'" |
| `readonlyWhen: record.account.tier == 'gold'` — update writing the field / update not writing it / insert | REFUSED / accepted / accepted |
| option `visibleWhen: record.account.tier == 'enterprise'` picked with a `gold` and an `enterprise` account | both ACCEPTED (fail-open, gate never enforced) |
| `requiredWhen: previous.account.tier == 'gold'` — update | REFUSED |
| `requiredWhen: parent.account.tier == 'gold'` on a detail line — insert | REFUSED |
| the prescribed rewrites: script `record.account.tier == 'enterprise' && (record.po_number == null or empty)`; script with `events: ['update']` and `record.account.tier == 'gold' && record.discount != previous.discount` | refused exactly on the failure rows, accepted otherwise |

## Verification — HEAD `55f3d0a800`

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` — 4162 passed; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` — exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration test/validate-field-predicate-traversal.test.ts` — 2 passed. `--project unit test/vitest-tiers-partition.test.ts` — 22 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` — exit 0. The rest of the CLI unit and integration tiers: not run locally, declared to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local src/migrations src/data` — 3307 passed, 2 todo (a declared narrowing of the spec suite); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` — exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` — all 15 artifacts up to date.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-field-predicate-fault.test.ts` (read-only control) — 13 passed; the runtime refusal is unchanged.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran …` — `112 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 110 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED`. NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: unrelated packages have no local dist); `check:type-check-debt` (its re-measure leg rebuilds package closures; the one local run hit my 400s wrapper and was killed; repo-wide ratchet, CI-owned). Every other family exit 0.
- ESLint, narrowed and proven: the 6 changed TypeScript files, `eslint --no-inline-config --format json`: 6 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The config never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, per `eslint.config.mjs`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Reverse verification

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `validate-expressions.ts`, anchor `for (const { root, types, owner } of holders) {` → `… of [] as FieldTraversalHolder[]) {` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `42952246fad7` → `15165f37c26b`), then the lint test file: **10 failed, 327 passed** — exactly the 10 refusal cases; all 8 controls stayed green. Restored: blob == HEAD (`42952246fad7`), `git diff HEAD` empty; re-run 337 passed. The lint tests import the rule from `src`, so no build sits between the mutation and the reading. The door's before/after is H1 above: the unfixed dist passed the config, the fixed dist refuses it.

## Acceptance notes

- **`Clause-②` arm.** The claim's line is `Clause-②: no` with no arm, copied verbatim above. The change narrows `objectstack validate`'s accept set, which `clause2-line.mjs` spells `no (narrowing)`; breaking-ness is carried in the changeset by the `!` summary and the `**BREAKING**` banner instead, and the ADR-0087 gate reads it (`[BREAKING+bang]`).
- **Runtime wording for `previous` / `parent` traversals** (same family, not filed, carrier: none). The probe shows the runtime refusing them with the generic sentence "reads 'tier', which this object does not declare — fix the rule's condition, or declare the field", the repair the runtime's own docblock calls wrong for a traversal; its specific sentence recognises the `record` root only. With this PR authoring refuses both with the right repair, so the runtime sentence is reached only by metadata that never passes the authoring rule. `rule-validator.ts` is `domain:engine` and outside this claim.
- **Stored objects are not re-judged.** This rule's runtime publish-gate surface covers flow / action / hook writes, not object writes, so an object saved through Studio, REST or `sys_metadata` keeps being refused at write time exactly as before.
- **Coverage boundary.** Injected system columns (`owner_id`, `created_by`, …) carry no type in the lint index, so a read through one is not refused (a missed finding, never a false one). Field-level `visibleWhen`, form-view option `visibleWhen` and action-param option `visibleWhen` are outside the three slots triage named and are not judged.
- **Shared describe.** `FormSelectOptionSchema` reuses `SelectOptionSchema.visibleWhen` by reference, so the option's `.describe()` also renders on the form-view face; the added sentence is scoped to "an OBJECT field's option" so it stays true there. The pre-existing sentence ("The one VISIBILITY predicate the SERVER also enforces") renders on the form-view face too; not measured here.
- **Not merged with `main`.** Base `49144fc`; `origin/main` has moved (including new step-18 registry entries). A driver-less `git merge-tree` probe (bare shared clone, no `merge.os-regen` driver) merged clean. `dispatch-gates.mjs` flagged the tree as behind `origin/main` with its own family files changed there, so the family list above is this tree's.
